required_coverage.detail: The paper fit anchor is fiscal-year 1988–2002. The exact historical Compustat vintage, row coverage, and old item-to-current-column mapping are unverified.

variable_coverage.construction: INEW_t = ITOTAL_t − IMAINTENANCE_t; ITOTAL = CAPX + acquisitions + R&D − SalePPE; maintenance = depreciation and amortization. Scale the annual measure by average total assets; exact current-field mapping and average-asset timing remain uncertain.

Prior-year V/P = VAIP divided by market equity (Compustat price item 25 × shares item 199); VAIP uses common equity, annual dividends, and operating income after depreciation with r=0.12 and persistence 0.62. The source PDF’s multiplication was visually verified; exact local vintage/field mapping is unresolved.
Prior-year leverage uses book short- and long-term debt divided by book total debt plus book equity. Current Compustat debt/equity fields are candidates; item mapping is unverified.
Prior-period cash and short-term investments scaled by total assets at the start of the year; field/date alignment is not specified beyond the paper’s definition.
Log years listed on CRSP as of the start of the prior period; requires date-effective GVKEY/PERMNO mapping and full CRSP history back to first listing.
Log total assets measured at the start of the prior period; exact beginning-of-fiscal/calendar-year mapping is not stated.
Prior-year change in firm market value. The source does not define exact endpoints, fiscal/calendar alignment, or whether dividends/corporate-action adjustments enter.
Lagged INEW is its own prior-year value, constructed from ITOTAL−IMAINTENANCE and scaled by average assets; because it is t−1, the average-asset denominator reaches t−2.

Residual from Table 2 Model IV, observed INEW_t less its fitted value; INEW uses current-year investment components and average total assets. The support model’s underlying raw inputs are separately mapped in the supporting model entries.
FCF<0_t equals FCF_t when FCF_t<0 and zero otherwise; FCF_t = CFO_t−D&A_t+R&D_t−fitted INEW_t, scaled by average total assets.
FCF>0_t equals FCF_t when FCF_t>0 and zero otherwise; FCF_t = CFO_t−D&A_t+R&D_t−fitted INEW_t, scaled by average total assets.

design_coverage.reason: No clustering groups are reported. The paper states Huber–White robust standard errors for pooled estimates; that correction is retained as reported and not recast as a cluster design.
The frozen baseline is the pooled Table 3 Panel B single-fit regression and depends on the Table 2 Model IV pooled fitted values/residuals; the underlying estimator is not named in the paper.
The required Table 2 support fit includes annual and Fama–French industry indicators; the Table 3 pooled baseline equation has no stated fixed effects. Industry mapping is separately required.
Compustat GVKEY and dated CRSP PERMNO histories need date-effective CCM links; link rules and complete coverage are unverified.

Use average-assets scaling, the reported extreme FCF/potential-use exclusion, and 1st/99th percentile V/P winsorization; exact historic item mapping and percentile reference population/order remain unresolved.
The source reports FY1988–2002 and 58,053 rows, with active and inactive securities and SIC 6000–6999 excluded; the row roster is unverified.
No weighting scheme is reported for the frozen pooled Table 3 or supporting Table 2 regression.

implementation_issues.description: The historical Compustat item numbers in the paper are not a verified semantic mapping to the current SAS fields or the paper-era product/vintage. The exact numerator/denominator fields for leverage, annual dividends, book equity, market price/shares, cash-flow items and each potential-use sample screen require item-level mapping; matching labels/field presence alone does not prove equivalent historical definitions or units.

The paper does not specify the exact GVKEY-to-PERMNO link choice, fiscal-year/actual-date matching, CRSP security aggregation, or how CRSP listing age was calculated. The age measure requires history back to each firm’s first CRSP listing, which has no source-bounded starting date; probes confirm only fields, not valid links or population coverage.

Stock Returns is described as the prior-year change in market value, but the source does not define return endpoints, fiscal versus calendar-year alignment, or whether dividends/corporate-action adjustments enter. Compustat fyear labels and actual datadate are distinct from CRSP calendar dates.

The 58,053-row sample rule excludes absolute deflated FCF and potential-use values above one and winsorizes V/P at p1/p99, but exact current-field mappings, percentile reference population, missing-data/order rules, and the row roster are not established. Do not substitute winsorization for the stated FCF/use exclusion.

The source reports 43 Fama–French (1997) industry indicators but does not provide the included SIC groups or reference category. The current official Data Library page describes a SIC-based 48-industry classification; the paper’s 43-indicator grouping and timing are not fully reconciled.

The paper identifies pooled regressions and Huber–White robust standard errors but does not name the exact underlying estimator. Preserve the reported pooled design and robust correction without inferring an unreported clustering structure or estimator.

The paper uses an early-2000s Compustat/CRSP extraction for observations through FY2002. The available local probes establish current route/field presence only; historical revisions, vintage differences and their effect on the 58,053-observation count are not quantified.

review_notes: This fit is undetermined because the source-cohort, historical link, field-mapping, stock-return timing and design details are not confirmed; live fields alone do not establish coverage.
